Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry in Bangladesh responsible for the administration of internal resources, including customs and taxation matters.
Internal Resources Division: This is the administrative division under the Ministry of Finance responsible for issuing customs-related notifications and governing taxation policies.

Customs Act 1969: This SRO is issued under the powers granted by sub-section (1) of section 19 of the Customs Act 1969 to revise existing duty rates.
National Board of Revenue: The Government has issued this order after consulting with the National Board of Revenue in the interest of the public.
First Schedule: This order modifies the import duty rates for specific goods categorized under the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.
H.S. Code: The order specifies new customs duty rates for various sugar products identified by their respective Heading and H.S. Code numbers as listed in the table.
Customs Duty: This order establishes revised specific import duty rates for different classifications of raw and refined sugar, measured by metric ton, replacing the previous duty amounts.
